_comment: Golden renderings of a tool result, shared by the Go implementation (internal/tool.Render) and its TypeScript twin (web/src/tool.ts renderResult). Both must produce `want` byte for byte. stdout/stderr are plain text here, not base64: the Go test wraps them into a protocol.Response and the TS test into a Response, which is where the two languages' decoded shapes already agree.

cases.name: stdout and stderr are separate blocks, stdout first
a silent command says so rather than rendering an empty block
non-zero exit is a result, not an error
timed out is flagged on the exit_code line
truncated is flagged on the exit_code line
an agent error replaces the no-output line

response.error: chdir /nope: no such file or directory

cases.want:
exit_code: 1
error: chdir /nope: no such file or directory

cases.name: an agent error still shows whatever output there was
cases.want:
exit_code: 1
error: response exceeds frame limit

<stdout>
partial
</stdout>

cases.name: output with no trailing newline still closes on its own line
exactly one trailing newline is trimmed, so a blank last line survives
